snippet.title: Flick Shot Rogues - Out Now!
snippet.description:
Get it 10% Off During Launch - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2427450/Flick_Shot_Rogues/

Plan, Aim, Shoot! FLICK SHOT ROGUES blends the tactile satisfaction of flicking stuff across a table with the strategic depth of your favorite turnbased roguelikes. Chain together ridiculous combos, unlock characters, items and skills, and conquer the island!

⚡ Fast, tactile combat – flick figurines to attack & combo
🪙 Roguelike runs – unlock relics, skills & new heroes
🏴‍☠️ Pirate mystery – battle spooky foes & hunt treasure
